subject: Supplier Intake Kickoff — MAP, PO path, and success criteria
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@silverline.io>
Cc: k ar thik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier Intake Kickoff — next steps and proposed times

Hi Liam — great to connect earlier. Thanks for choosing Redwood for your inference layer.

Quick note to get the procurement kickoff scheduled and make sure we have the right docs ahead of time. Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
- 5m introductions and scope
- 10m mutual action plan (MAP) walkthrough (milestones & owners)
- 10m PO path & billing/power-of-attorney questions
- 10–20m integration prerequisites & documentation requests (SOC 2, IP/DSAR process)

Please confirm which of these slots works for you this week:
- Tue Aug 10 11:00–11:45 PT
- Tue Aug 10 15:00–15:45 PT
- Wed Aug 11 09:00–09:45 PT

Two asks before the call:
1) If procurement has a standard PO form, could you attach it or share a link?
2) Please share the primary procurement contact for Silverline (name, email, phone).

I attached a lightweight onboarding checklist to accelerate the intake. We'll use the MAP doc during the call and capture owners/timing.

Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Vendor Success Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: supplier-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@silverline.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Harper Tech <harper.tech@acme.org>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 16:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Supplier Intake Kickoff — next steps and proposed times

Camila — thanks for the clear agenda. Tue Aug 10 at 15:00 PT works best for our team (I know it crosses lunch for us but we can make it).

Procurement POC is Harper Tech (procurement@silverline.io) — copying them. I attached our standard PO template here (see stub). We also require our vendor form filled (I can attach after this message if helpful).

A couple of notes to flag for the call:
- We need to confirm data handling boundaries up front (Silverline is HIPAA-adjacent; limited PHI touchpoints).
- Our legal team will likely want a short lead time for SOW/ordering language (2–3 business days).

See you Tuesday.

—Liam
Head of Product, Silverline Health
attachments: silverline_PO_template.docx

Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier Intake Kickoff — next steps and proposed times

Thanks Camila — I will join Tuesday's call and own clarifying our PO & billing path. A few internal notes I'll bring:
- Standard Redwood PO flow: PO -> Finance review (1 business day) -> Compliance intake (if required) -> activation (once invoice/PO match)
- If Silverline needs vendor onboarding forms filled, we can provide a prefilled Redwood vendor packet; please share your version and procurement timeboxes
- If procurement needs net-45/60 payment terms, we should flag for Sales Ops (Marissa) during the call so we can route the credit approval pre-call when possible

Camila: I took the liberty of adding a PO readiness checklist to the onboarding file (column: finance prerequisites).

-karthik

Redwood Inference

Thanks all — invite sent for Tue Aug 10 15:00 PT. Attaching the Redwood MAP (v1) and the checklist with preliminary owners and dates. Highlights to review before the call:
- Success criteria (what "go-live" looks like): provisioning in dedicated account, two test prompts validated, billing configured and PO accepted
- Key milestones: intake docs (by Aug 13), procurement approval (by Aug 17), activation window (Aug 18–20)
- Owners: Camila (onboarding), Karthik (procurement), Liam (Silverline technical lead), Harper (procurement approver)

Action items before the kickoff:
1) Silverline: upload PO template & vendor form to the calendar event (Liam/Harper) — due Aug 11 EOD
2) Redwood: prefill vendor packet & finance checklist — Camila & Karthik — due Aug 12 noon PT
3) Legal touchpoint: if Silverline needs SOW edits, flag during the call so Sales Ops (Marissa) can drive approval path

Attachments: redwood-MAP-v1.pdf, supplier-onboarding-checklist.xlsx
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-kickoff

Look forward to a productive call.

-Camila

Redwood Inference

- Silverline requires Redwood to provide a data processing addendum (DPA) that aligns with HIPAA-adjacent controls — can your compliance team confirm a templated DPA?

Liam and I will be on Tuesday. See you then.
